_about: THE one price list: TODAY'S prices, as the five games charge them (owner decision 9 Oct 2026, boss decision c of 27 Oct 2026). Rupees and US dollars, no GST, ending in 99 / whole dollars. Every game's pricing.ts and common.js is checked against this file by tests/prices.test.ts. There is no second ladder and no 50-person size.
